posts.title: Frozen berries recalled nationwide over norovirus concerns
posts.body:
← Back to Youdle

Several popular brands of frozen berries have been recalled after routine testing found possible norovirus contamination. The affected lots were distributed to grocery chains in 28 states.

posts.title: Grocery prices ease for the first time in months—here’s what dropped
posts.body: From eggs to cereal, see the items finally getting a little cheaper. The latest basket data shows the first month-over-month decline since last autumn.

posts.title: Recall alert: Chicken soup products recalled
posts.body: Several canned soup products have been recalled due to a labeling error that omits a known allergen. Shoppers are asked to check lot codes before eating.
